settings.heading: A chore that never ends deserved a real fix.
settings.text: We loved our cats. We did not love the twice-daily scoop, the smell, or the worry about whether everyone was using the box normally. The auto boxes we tried were loud, cramped or cheap — so we built the one we wished existed.

settings.heading: Quiet by default. Honest by design.

settings.title: Cats first
settings.text: Every decision — the slow rotation, the quiet motor, the wide doorway — starts with what's calm and safe for the cat.

settings.title: No lock-in
settings.text: No proprietary litter, no mandatory subscriptions. You own it outright and run it your way.

settings.title: Built to last
settings.text: Replaceable parts, a 2-year warranty and lifetime support — because good hardware shouldn't be disposable.
